marketSummary: U.S. equities declined across the board this morning, with the Dow Jones Industrial Average (DIA) leading losses at -1.80%, followed by the S&P 500 (SPY) at -1.58%, while small-caps (IWM) showed relative resilience at -1.04%. Without material news catalysts, today's selloff appears to reflect broader macro concerns or profit-taking ahead of potential economic data releases.
